The simulation confirms a structural liquidity vaporization event. Unlike the managed volatility decay observed in the LFY 2025 baseline, current Gamma Exposure (GEX) on major BTC/ETH futures has inverted to -15.2%, triggering a cascade of dealer hedging that forces price discovery rather than dampening it. This is not a correction; it is a liquidity flush. Retail volume—up 40% YoY—is dismissed as transient noise; these are bagholders catching falling knives, not institutional accumulation.

Volatility surfaces have exploded. The term structure is in severe backwardation, with 1-month implieds skewing to 140% of 3-month tenors. The correlation coefficient with the Nasdaq-100 has spiked to 0.92, dragging high-beta tech into the maelstrom. This contagion has fractured the cross-asset basis. We are witnessing a flight to quality that has crushed the "risk-on" narrative.

Systemic friction is immediate. Overnight Indexed Swap (OIS) spreads have widened 45bps as collateral calls force a scramble for high-quality liquid assets (HQLA). The 10Y Treasury yield is spiking toward 5.2% not on growth, but on technical liquidation of duration hedges. Flows are aggressively rotating into T-Bills and short-duration cash, draining equity beta.

The 2026 pivot is dead on arrival. With the VIX breaking 45 and Repo rates eclipsing 6.0%, central banks cannot afford to ease liquidity without validating hyperinflationary expectations in real assets. We remain net short volatility and neutral duration. The structural fragility of the 2026-2027 horizon is now the primary driver of capital preservation.
